newsitems.title: Official Trailer is Here!
newsitems.author: EgoTrampoline
newsitems.contents: Our official trailer has arrived!Step into the forgotten cellar, restore 2,448 bottles, uncover the story behind the mysterious chicken, and experience Cellar Keeper before launch.We've also updated our Steam page with new screenshots, an improved description, and more details about the game.📅 Launching August 6 (US) / August 7 (EU & Asia)Thank you for all the incredible support so far. We can't wait for you to play! ❤️EgoTrampoline

newsitems.title: What's Next for Cellar Keeper?
newsitems.author: EgoTrampoline
newsitems.contents: While our main focus is polishing Cellar Keeper for launch, we've already started planning what's next.Here's a small preview of what we'd love to add after release:🛡️ Hardcore ModeA more realistic way to play.Bottles can break if dropped.Carry fewer bottles at once.Watch your step... you might break one yourself.One mistake could mean starting over.🏚️ A New CellarA brand-new cellar to restore.A completely new cellar to explore.More bottles to organize.New fictional brands to collect.New organization challenges.Finally, thank you for helping us reach 20,000 wishlists!Every wishlist, comment, and message means more than you know. Your support keeps us motivated every day, and we can't wait for you to experience Cellar Keeper on launch.❤️EgoTrampoline

newsitems.title: Thank You for 10,000 Wishlists! 🎉
newsitems.author: EgoTrampoline
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone!We've just reached 10,000 wishlists on Steam! 🎉Reaching this milestone means a lot to us, and we want to thank everyone who has wishlisted Cellar Keeper, shared it with friends, or simply followed its journey so far.Every bit of support has helped more people discover the game, and it's been incredible to watch the community continue to grow.We're still hard at work polishing the experience, improving every detail, and making sure the cellar is ready for launch.If you know someone who enjoys organizing games, relaxing gameplay, or chasing the perfect Speedrun, we'd love it if you shared Cellar Keeper with them.Thank you again for being part of this journey. We can't wait for you to step into the cellar.❤️EgoTrampoline

newsitems.title: Thank You for 7,500 Wishlists! 🎉
newsitems.author: EgoTrampoline
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone!We've just reached 7,500 wishlists on Steam!It's been amazing to watch more and more people discover Cellar Keeper, and we wanted to take a moment to thank everyone who's been following the game.Every wishlist, share, and kind message helps us reach more players, and we truly appreciate all the support we've received.Development is progressing well, and we're continuing to polish every corner of the cellar before launch. We're excited to share more updates with you very soon.If you know someone who enjoys organizing games, relaxing gameplay, or simply making things tidy, we'd love it if you shared Cellar Keeper with them.Thank you again for being part of this journey. ❤️EgoTrampoline

newsitems.title: Thank You for 5,000 Wishlists! 🎉
newsitems.author: EgoTrampoline
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone!We've just reached 5,000 wishlists on Steam!It's amazing to see so many people excited about Cellar Keeper, and we wanted to take a moment to say thank you.Every wishlist, comment, share, and kind message has helped more people discover the game. Your support has been incredible, and we truly appreciate every single one of you.Development is progressing well, and we're working hard to make Cellar Keeper the best experience it can be. We can't wait to share more updates as we get closer to launch.If you know someone who enjoys cozy organizing games, sharing Cellar Keeper with them is one of the best ways to support us.Thank you again for being part of this journey. We couldn't have reached this milestone without you.❤️EgoTrampoline

newsitems.title: 2,448 Bottles. 2,448 Wishlists.
newsitems.author: EgoTrampoline
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone!We've just reached 2,448 wishlists on Steam, and we wanted to celebrate this fun little coincidence.🍾 2,448 Bottles. ❤️ 2,448 Wishlists.If every wishlist carried just one bottle, organizing the cellar would be easy.Thank you so much for all the support. Every wishlist, comment, and share helps more people discover Cellar Keeper.We're continuing to polish the game and can't wait to share more as we get closer to launch.Thanks for being part of the journey. ❤️EgoTrampoline

newsitems.title: Thank You for 1,000 Wishlists! 🎉
newsitems.author: EgoTrampoline
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone!We've just reached 1,000 wishlists on Steam, and we wanted to say thank you.Seeing so many people interested in Cellar Keeper means a lot to our two-person team. Every wishlist motivates us to keep polishing the game and make it the best experience we can.Development is moving forward, and we're looking forward to sharing more gameplay, behind-the-scenes updates, and new features over the coming weeks.If you haven't already, feel free to share Cellar Keeper with friends who enjoy cozy organizing games. It truly helps us reach more players.Thank you again for being part of this journey.❤️EgoTrampoline

newsitems.title: Cellar Keeper Has Officially Been Announced!
newsitems.author: EgoTrampoline
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone!We're excited to finally reveal Cellar Keeper, our cozy first-person organizing game.Restore a forgotten cellar by sorting 2,448 bottles into their proper racks. Organize collections by variety, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy a relaxing experience at your own pace. If you're looking for a challenge, Speedrun Mode lets you compete for the fastest completion time on the online leaderboards.🎥 Watch the announcement trailer below!If you enjoy cozy organizing games, we hope you'll enjoy what we've been creating.Thanks for checking out Cellar Keeper!— EgoTrampoline
